!1 Scenarios

|scenario           |Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|params|With Data|!-SubTestData-!|
|start              |!-SlimProxy.Process-!                                     |
|set working dir    |${TEST_DATA_ROOT}\@SubTestData                            |
|add environment var|GEMINI_CLI               |value |1                        |
|ensure             |run                      |${DPT_EXE} @params              |
|push fixture                                                                  |

|scenario           |Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|params|With Data|!-SubTestData-!|
|start              |!-SlimProxy.Process-!                                     |
|set working dir    |${TEST_DATA_ROOT}\@SubTestData                            |
|add environment var|GEMINI_CLI               |value |1                        |
|reject             |run                      |${DPT_EXE} @params              |
|push fixture                                                                  |
